description: Get the TEXT of a section of the Commonwealth Code of the Northern Mariana Islands (CNMI statutes) by citation, e.g. "6 CMC § 1101" (murder) or "6 CMC 1101". Accepts natural forms: "6 CMC 1101", "6 CMC § 1101", "Title 6 Section 1101". Returns the catchline and statutory text. Tries the official cnmilaw.org site live first; cnmilaw.org has been down since around 2026-10 (a registrar-level suspension, confirmed via both a normal connection and a Cloudflare edge probe) so most calls currently fall back to the Internet Archive Wayback Machine's own crawl of the same official PDF — every response says which route it used, with data_as_of and a staleness warning on the fallback. Use for "what does 6 CMC 1101 say" or to check a Northern Mariana Islands statute.

citation.description: Section citation, e.g. "6 CMC 1101" or "6 CMC § 1101" (title 1-10, then section number).
